lena_sales: Hey team — NorthCove (regional retail bank) asked for a 2-week proof-of-concept. They want: 1) acceptance criteria 2) token budget estimate 3) baseline prompt set + evals. Can SE/ML help define? cc @ana_se @ryan_ml

mike_eng: Got it. Quick Q: what's the primary user flow? customer says \"support triage + KYC extraction\"?

lena_sales: Yes — two flows: (A) support triage -> intent + next-action (B) doc ingestion -> structured KYC extraction + short summary. Concurrency target ~50 reqs/sec peak. Typical input ~200 tokens.

ana_se: For POC, propose a minimal prompt inventory: intent classification, action mapping, extract KYC fields, summarize, safety filter, reranker for doc hits. I'll sketch samples.

ana_se: ```
# intent
You are an assistant that classifies customer messages into intents: {billing, login, refund, other}.
Input: "{user_message}"
Output: <intent>
```

ana_se: ```
# extraction
Extract fields: full_name, dob, account_number (redact if partial), reason_summary.
Input: "{document}"
Output: JSON: {"full_name": "...", "dob": "...", "account_number":"...", "reason_summary":"..."}
```

ryan_ml: Good. For baseline evals: use 100 seed examples per flow, measure extraction exact-match + F1, intent micro-F1. Acceptance targets: extraction F1 >= 0.88, intent acc >= 0.92, summary ROUGE-L > 0.45. Infra SLO: latency p95 < 350ms on a dedicated S instance.

jade_cs: Customer also asked about token burn and rough price. What's realistic for 1k daily active users?

mike_eng: Back-of-envelope: avg request 200 input + 150 output = 350 tokens. 1k DAU -> 350k tokens/day -> ~10.5M tokens/month. Add evals + overhead -> ~13M tokens/month. At hosted rates (~$0.00002/token) -> ~ $260/month. We should present both hosted estimate and Dedicated capacity quote.

lena_sales: Can we offer a token cap for the trial and a simple cost-share?

ana_se: Yes. We'll set a console quota and use shorter system prompts during POC. Recommend prefix caching for template-heavy flows to reduce token burn.

ops-bot: Reminder: Private deploys require KMS + IP allowlist. Customer asked for EU data residency and no PII in logs. :warning:

lena_sales: They need EU residency and explicit no-PII-logging for the POC. Can we enable PII redaction in the ingestion pipeline?

ryan_ml: We can run a PII redaction pass before logging. For the model path, configure no-persist for KV cache and disable debug dumps. Will need security signoff and a short checklist.

mike_eng: Proposed timeline:
- Week 0 (kick): gather 100 sample tickets + 200 doc pages, legal intro, sizing.
- Week 1: prompt curation + seed evals (100 examples/flow).
- Week 2: integration, load test, run acceptance suite, final report.
Deliverables: prompt inventory (samples + templates), eval report, token-burn estimate, runbook for handoff.

lena_sales: OK — I'll send this plan to the customer and request the sample data & legal contact. Any immediate blockers?

ana_se: Need anonymized dataset and confirmation on concurrency number to size Dedicated. Also need DSGVO contact for data processing agreement.

jade_cs: I'll own customer comms and loop in Legal. tagging @mike_eng for any infra notes.

mike_eng: I'll draft minimal quota policy and a short config snippet for the console. POC can run in hosted EU with a reserved small instance for consistent latency; we can enable burst if needed.

lena_sales: Thanks. Can everyone ack so I can share the plan? :thumbsup:

mike_eng: ack

ana_se: ack

ryan_ml: ack

jade_cs: ack

ops-bot: POC workspace created: https://console.redwood.ai/poc/NC-1747 (credentials sent to project leads)
